result_text:
`all_files.zip` is now built from the configured aspect names, so renaming an aspect no longer breaks the export.

**What changed:** `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`, in the zip section of `exportJson()` (around line 641). The five hardcoded `aspect_*.txt` literals are replaced by a loop over the five scope aspects. Each entry name and read path comes from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same helper that writes the loose files. Entries stay in the same order: main, test, generated, build and deployment, other.

**Why `git-history.zip` was lost too:** it sits in the same `try` block, after the failing `all_files.zip` read. The `FileNotFoundException` jumped past it to the `catch`. With the names fixed, both zips are written again. I did not restructure the `try`.

**Verification:** `mvn -q -o -pl reports test` passes. I did not run the renamed-aspect scenario end to end, so the `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt` output is unverified against a real run. No commit made.
